gspells.dbf.description: Inflicts 60 points of earth damage at the center of the spell area

gspells.dbf.name: Gust
gspells.dbf.description: Inflicts 75 points of air damage to target units

gspells.dbf.name: Mold
gspells.dbf.description: Reduces by 80 the armor of target units

gspells.dbf.name: Gallean's Curse
gspells.dbf.description: Reduces by 33% the damage inflicted by enchanted units in battle

gspells.dbf.name: Gallean's Boon
gspells.dbf.description: Adds 50 hit points to enchanted units

gspells.dbf.name: Summon IV: Verdant
gspells.dbf.description: Summons the forest Verdant

gspells.dbf.name: Wrath of the Glades
gspells.dbf.description: Inflicts 125 points of earth damage to target unit

gspells.dbf.name: Sinkhole
gspells.dbf.description: Destroys target rod

gspells.dbf.name: Create Forest

gunits.dbf.name: Squire
gunits.dbf.description: The Squire nobly offers protection to his weaker compatriots in battle, fighting off all attackers with his sword.

gunits.dbf.name: Knight
gunits.dbf.description: The Knight uses his divine strength to guard the Empire against iniquity.

gunits.dbf.name: Imperial Knight
gunits.dbf.description: The Imperial Knight's absolute faith propels him to defend the innocent, making him a formidable adversary.

gunits.dbf.name: Witch-Hunter
gunits.dbf.description: The Witch-Hunter is immune to mind based attacks through his experience in battling evil forces.

gunits.dbf.name: Inquisitor
gunits.dbf.description: Long devoted to the task of eradicating evil, the Inquisitor attacks with holy force and is not affected by mind based attacks.

gunits.dbf.name: Archer
gunits.dbf.description: The Archer's attack is swift and far-reaching, making him effective against magic-users that shield themselves behind their stronger comrades.

gunits.dbf.name: Marksman
gunits.dbf.description: The Marksman has great skill with the bow; his arrows fly far and a single hit can mean death to his opponents.

gunits.dbf.name: Apprentice
gunits.dbf.description: The Apprentice unleashes lightning upon all enemy units, he attacks with vengeance from a distance.

gunits.dbf.name: Mage
gunits.dbf.description: Casting lightning with double the violence, the Mage shows no mercy to adversaries.

gunits.dbf.name: Wizard
gunits.dbf.description: The Wizard is a peerless spellcaster; he calls down mighty bolts of lightning from the heavens.

gunits.dbf.name: Acolyte
gunits.dbf.description: As a healer, the Acolyte comes to the aid of one unit at a time in combat.

gunits.dbf.name: Priest
gunits.dbf.description: Priests can substantially heal damaged units. They patiently attend to one soldier at a time during battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Imperial Priest
gunits.dbf.description: The Imperial Priest is blessed with the ability to cure units; the wounded will recover much of their health under his individual care.

gunits.dbf.name: Angel
gunits.dbf.description: An emissary of the Highfather, the Angel's holy lance smites all those who threaten the Empire.

gunits.dbf.name: Paladin
gunits.dbf.description: The Paladin has been granted the best armor in the land to staunchly defend his people against unholy forces.

gunits.dbf.name: Cleric
gunits.dbf.description: The Cleric brings down divine aid to heal all injured in her party.

gunits.dbf.name: Matriarch
gunits.dbf.description: The Matriarch's prayers miraculously heal all in her party.

gunits.dbf.name: Titan
gunits.dbf.description: The Titan is an immense, stalwart creature; she towers far above enemy armies.

gunits.dbf.name: Pegasus Knight
gunits.dbf.description: The Pegasus Knight is a noble fighter whose winged steed carries him high above forests and sea.

gunits.dbf.name: Ranger
gunits.dbf.description: Traveling quickly around the realm, the Ranger is often sent on scouting missions by the King.

gunits.dbf.name: Archmage
gunits.dbf.description: Master of the arcane, an Archmage is the only Empire leader who can use staffs and scrolls.

gunits.dbf.name: Arch-Angel
gunits.dbf.description: The Archangel claims land for the Empire by planting rods. The ground surrounding her rods magically converts into Empire soil.

gunits.dbf.name: Thief
gunits.dbf.description: Thieves are adept at mischief, and can sneak behind enemy lines to secure information important to the Empire's cause.

gunits.dbf.name: Living Armor
gunits.dbf.description: A powerful suit of armor come to life. It wields a mighty blade, destined to slay all foes.

gunits.dbf.name: Golem
gunits.dbf.description: The enchanted form of the earth Golem obeys its maker; it will stop only when its lifeless body is reduced to dust.

gunits.dbf.name: Axe Thrower
gunits.dbf.description: The Axe Thrower's great strength and ferocious fighting spirit allows it to reach any unit during battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Crossbowman
gunits.dbf.description: Crossbowmen rain death upon their adversaries with each volley.

gunits.dbf.name: Flame Caster
gunits.dbf.description: Flinging fire into the fray, the Flame Caster's attack reaches all members of the enemy party.

gunits.dbf.name: Hill Giant
gunits.dbf.description: The Hill Giant possesses strength so great that it chooses an uprooted tree as its weapon.

gunits.dbf.name: Rock Giant
gunits.dbf.description: The massive Rock Giant hurls giant boulders at its foe.

gunits.dbf.name: Tempest Giant
gunits.dbf.description: They descend from the skies to bring lightning storms down on all those who offend the Dwarves.

gunits.dbf.name: Ice Giant
gunits.dbf.description: The Ice Giant is called from frigid mountain peaks to fight for the clan's cause.

gunits.dbf.name: Tenderfoot
gunits.dbf.description: The Tenderfoot's gentle arts increase the force of her allies in battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Novice
gunits.dbf.description: The magical potions of the Novice increase the damage of one unit in battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Druidess
gunits.dbf.description: The Druidess is an adept who cures her allies and can magically add to the force of their weapon.

gunits.dbf.name: Dwarf
gunits.dbf.description: The Dwarf rushes valiantly into battle, knowing that Wotan protects the brave of heart.

gunits.dbf.name: Warrior
gunits.dbf.description: The Warrior is always ready to battle for the glory of his God, Wotan.

gunits.dbf.name: Veteran
gunits.dbf.description: The Veteran has meted out justice to many. He desires to one day die with honor in battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Dwarf King
gunits.dbf.description: Dwarves rewarded for unusual skill in battle by being named King of their Clan. Dwarf Kings wear the finest dwarven armor.

gunits.dbf.name: Venerable Warrior
gunits.dbf.description: Dwarves who have seen many years of battle, Venerable Warriors fight with the ferocity of those who have no fear of the world beyond.

gunits.dbf.name: Mountaineer
gunits.dbf.description: Well adapted to hostile climes, the Mountaineer showers entire armies with icy shards culled from mountain glaciers.

gunits.dbf.name: Polar Bear
gunits.dbf.description: Polar Bears reside in the snow-laden mountaintops of the realm; they defend against those who invade their territory.

gunits.dbf.name: Yeti
gunits.dbf.description: With a thick hide and icy breath, the Yeti has sent many an adventurer to an early grave.

gunits.dbf.name: King's Guard
gunits.dbf.description: As warlike leaders, the King's Guards are sent to quell any danger that threatens the dwarven lands.

gunits.dbf.name: Engineer
gunits.dbf.description: Engineers travel far and wide, keeping the High King informed of happenings in the Dwarven Lands.

gunits.dbf.name: Loremaster
gunits.dbf.description: The Loremaster collects the ancestral wisdom of the Clans and has the ability to use staffs and scrolls.

gunits.dbf.name: Dwarf Champion
gunits.dbf.description: Chosen by Wotan to transform the land, the Dwarf Champion plants rods to expand the High King's territory.

gunits.dbf.name: Thief
gunits.dbf.description: A Thief has many tricks at his disposal that he employs to further the High King's cause.

gunits.dbf.name: Roc
gunits.dbf.description: Rocs are giant birds called down from the mountains to fight alongside the Clans in times of war.

gunits.dbf.name: Valkyrie
gunits.dbf.description: Hovering near battlefields to collect the fallen, these women warriors are fearsome when crossed.

gunits.dbf.name: Stone Ancestor
gunits.dbf.description: These statues are animated by the souls of fierce warriors of old.

gunits.dbf.name: Possessed
gunits.dbf.description: The Demon Lord enslaves these strong-bodied peasants to fight in his infernal battles.

gunits.dbf.name: Berzerker
gunits.dbf.description: As humanity weakens in these possessed creatures, their violence becomes uncontrollable.

gunits.dbf.name: Anti-Paladin
gunits.dbf.description: Demons have mastered the souls of these once holy warriors, their virtuous past has long been forgotten.

gunits.dbf.name: Gargoyle
gunits.dbf.description: Those who obey blindly the orders of cruel leaders become stone demons in the afterlife; They suffer in infernal fires, and turn slowly to stone.

gunits.dbf.name: Marble Gargoyle
gunits.dbf.description: Marble Gargoyles are the winged demons of the sixth plane of hell; they are impervious to mind attacks and their bodies are too solid to be easily damaged.

gunits.dbf.name: Devil
gunits.dbf.description: This unclean being menaces the land for his dark Lord Bethrezen.

gunits.dbf.name: Demon
gunits.dbf.description: Demons inhabit the lower regions of Hell, they are more powerful than the lesser devils.

gunits.dbf.name: Moloch
gunits.dbf.description: Molochs gain power and strength by devouring the souls of those they slay.

gunits.dbf.name: Beast
gunits.dbf.description: The great Beast the very form of maleficence, none can escape the reach of this monstrosity.

gunits.dbf.name: Demon Lord
gunits.dbf.description: The Demon Lord is a sovereign of Hell; As such, they lead devilish armies for Bethrezen.

gunits.dbf.name: Cultist
gunits.dbf.description: Humans that have an inborn affinity for evil; they call down fire on entire armies.

gunits.dbf.name: Sorcerer
gunits.dbf.description: Dark Sorcerers can summon fiery rain to consume enemy forces.

gunits.dbf.name: Demonologist
gunits.dbf.description: The Demonologist creates a storm of Flames so powerful that no army can escape it.

gunits.dbf.name: Incubus
gunits.dbf.description: The Incubus turns men to stone with his horrible death cries.

gunits.dbf.name: Pandemoneus
gunits.dbf.description: The Pandemoneous controls infernal fires, incinerating entire armies at once.

gunits.dbf.name: Witch
gunits.dbf.description: Witches dwell in the depths of forests; if bothered they have been known to retaliate by transforming the hated interlopers.

gunits.dbf.name: Hag
gunits.dbf.description: Hags have the ability to transform enemies into anything they desire.

gunits.dbf.name: Fiend
gunits.dbf.description: The Fiend hides its misshapen form within a labyrinthine lair. Few can resist its furious attack.

gunits.dbf.name: Duke
gunits.dbf.description: The Duke's warlike spirit leads demons into battle, sword in hand.

gunits.dbf.name: Counselor
gunits.dbf.description: The Counselor leads the vanguard of the Legions forces; he travels at high speed upon the lands.

gunits.dbf.name: Arch-Devil
gunits.dbf.description: The Archdevil is master of the arcane; he has knowledge of staffs and scrolls.

gunits.dbf.name: Baroness
gunits.dbf.description: Under the Baroness' control the realm transforms into a fiery wasteland.

gunits.dbf.name: Thief
gunits.dbf.description: The Thief is valued for his skill in subterfuge.

gunits.dbf.name: Hellhound
gunits.dbf.description: The Three-headed Cerebus guards Hell's denizens with his fiery breath.

gunits.dbf.name: Beliarh
gunits.dbf.description: The huge Beliarh demon skewers opponents with its humongous horns.

gunits.dbf.name: Avenger
gunits.dbf.description: The Avenger lives to punish those who doubt the authority of Bethrezen, ruler of hell.

gunits.dbf.name: Ghost
gunits.dbf.description: Ghosts are spirits bound by evil to the earth; they join their undead brethren's crusade.

gunits.dbf.name: Specter
gunits.dbf.description: A Specter's forceful spirit makes her paralyzing attack stronger.

gunits.dbf.name: Initiate
gunits.dbf.description: Initiates have been trained to spread death and disease upon living armies.

gunits.dbf.name: Warlock
gunits.dbf.description: Warlocks become more effective over time in their quest to spread pestilence on the lands.

gunits.dbf.name: Necromancer
gunits.dbf.description: The Necromancer has perfected his craft; pestilence will engulf any army he encounters.

gunits.dbf.name: Vampire
gunits.dbf.description: Men who have rejected the words of the Highfather become vampires. They sustain themselves by draining the life force of innocents.

gunits.dbf.name: Lich
gunits.dbf.description: Those who cultivate arcane knowledge in life become Liches; they infect the living with deadly plague winds.

gunits.dbf.name: Wraith
gunits.dbf.description: Wraiths pass over from the land of the undead to spread pestilence.

gunits.dbf.name: Fighter
gunits.dbf.description: These Fighters live again to crush the enemies of Mortis.

gunits.dbf.name: Zombie
gunits.dbf.description: Dead souls who have been transformed by ritual into mindless Zombies.

gunits.dbf.name: Skeleton Warrior
gunits.dbf.description: The Skeleton Warrior is compelled by the will of Mortis to fight alongside the Undead.

gunits.dbf.name: Skeleton Champion
gunits.dbf.description: Great fighting unit of the undead, the Skeleton Champion raises his bony fists against the living.

gunits.dbf.name: Templar
gunits.dbf.description: Templars subvert religious rites in order to honor Queen Mortis. They are impervious to the elements.

gunits.dbf.name: Dark Lord
gunits.dbf.description: Mortis grants the Dark Lords control over the elements as reward for their servitude.

gunits.dbf.name: Werewolf
gunits.dbf.description: The werewolf rampages by moonlight; He cannot be killed by any blade.

gunits.dbf.name: Wyvern
gunits.dbf.description: Sorcerers resurrect lifeless dragons, creating Wyverns to fight in their Undead armies.

gunits.dbf.name: Doomdrake
gunits.dbf.description: These awesome beasts breathed fire while living; now undead, they exhale poisonous vapors on enemy troops.

gunits.dbf.name: Deathdragon
gunits.dbf.description: Deathdragons terrorize the land from beyond the grave; their poisonous breath envelops entire armies during battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Death Knight
gunits.dbf.description: The Death Knight's ferocity in battle is unmatched. His great strength and flying ability are his greatest assets.

gunits.dbf.name: Nosferat
gunits.dbf.description: Nosferats drain the life force of their enemies in battle, weakening opponents while feeding thier own evil souls.

gunits.dbf.name: Lich Queen
gunits.dbf.description: Female Necromancers live after death as the dreadful Lich Queen. Their unholy knowledge allows them to use staffs and scrolls.

gunits.dbf.name: Banshee
gunits.dbf.description: Banshees plant rods on living soil and create from it a barren wasteland.

gunits.dbf.name: Thief
gunits.dbf.description: A Thief is sent by the king to enemy cities. There he uses his craft to outwit the enemy.

gunits.dbf.name: Skeleton
gunits.dbf.description: Frail skeletons magically animated and used by the Undead as scouts.

gunits.dbf.name: Evil Ent
gunits.dbf.description: Evil Ents are brought from the undead world through dark ceremony.

gunits.dbf.name: Nightmare
gunits.dbf.description: Crazy creatures called from the imagination of dark sorcerers, Nightmares brings death to Mortis' enemies.

gunits.dbf.name: Thanatos
gunits.dbf.description: Death comes forth by Mortis' command to fell the mortal armies of the Earth.

gunits.dbf.name: Hellhound
gunits.dbf.description: The Hellhound rushes into combat, spewing forth fire. Its illusory nature makes it immune to magic attacks.

gunits.dbf.name: Beliarh
gunits.dbf.description: The Beliarh is a horned menace summoned to fight Mortis' enemies.

gunits.dbf.name: Avenger
gunits.dbf.description: The Avenger is a fiery creature whose flames scorch entire armies.

gunits.dbf.name: Barbarian Chieftain
gunits.dbf.description: Barbarian tribes hail from the Northern Steppes, The Chieftain urges his warriors to go forth in search of treasure.

gunits.dbf.name: Peasant
gunits.dbf.description: Peasants defend the little turf that they can call home.

gunits.dbf.name: Red Dragon
gunits.dbf.description: The Mythological Red Dragon can be found near lava pits and volcanoes. Some say that they can live up to 4000 years

gunits.dbf.name: Lizard Man
gunits.dbf.description: Lizard men are the strange offspring of the marshlands; they are said to be particularly fond of human flesh.

gunits.dbf.name: Ogre
gunits.dbf.description: Ogres are thick-skulled warriors; they attack all comers without guile or stratagem.

gunits.dbf.name: Thug
gunits.dbf.description: Thugs assemble in bands to steal from unwary travelers and feeble peasants.

gunits.dbf.name: Forest Elf
gunits.dbf.description: Forest Elves move swiftly, surveying the frontiers and alerting their people of any intruders.

gunits.dbf.name: Troll
gunits.dbf.description: Trolls are exceedingly strong and resistant to attack, having the ability to regenerate each day.

gunits.dbf.name: Mermaid
gunits.dbf.description: The Mermaid paralyzes victims with its dazzling song, then feasts on the living flesh.

gunits.dbf.name: Orc Champion
gunits.dbf.description: Orc Champions lead greenskin armies in battle. Only orc's of the "Large Mouth" type can aspire to this position.

gunits.dbf.name: Goblin
gunits.dbf.description: Goblins are distant relations of the orc family. They are not strong creatures, but are limber and cunning.

gunits.dbf.name: Centaur
gunits.dbf.description: Centaurs are hotheaded fighters who will defend against any army.

gunits.dbf.name: Orc
gunits.dbf.description: Orcs of "Small mouth" status are used in the front lines of battle, being of tough build.

gunits.dbf.name: Man at Arms
gunits.dbf.description: Mercenaries who make their mighty services available to all, for a price.

gunits.dbf.name: Elf Lord
gunits.dbf.description: The Elf Lord staunchly defends his people by summoning powerful storms.

gunits.dbf.name: Elf Ranger
gunits.dbf.description: The Elf Ranger flings arrows at the enemy, and is able to attack from any distance.

gunits.dbf.name: Spearman
gunits.dbf.description: The Spearman will fight ferociously for whomever offers the most coin.

gunits.dbf.name: Ghoul
gunits.dbf.description: Ghouls are dangerous undead creatures; they attack those who come across them with tricks of the mind.

gunits.dbf.name: Imp
gunits.dbf.description: Demons send the ignoble Imp on errands of mischief in the realm.

gunits.dbf.description: The mythological White Dragon is a rare and beauteous sight. Some say that they live up to 3000 years

gunits.dbf.name: Green Dragon

gunits.dbf.description: The Giant Spiders' venom is poisonous; They agressively pursue any enemy they detect.

gunits.dbf.description: A grave danger while at sea, the Sea serpent has defeated many a great war vessel.

gunits.dbf.name: Kraken
gunits.dbf.description: A natural enemy of the Sea Serpent, the Kraken attacks seafarers that venture too close to its watery lair.

gunits.dbf.description: Centaur lancers are lovers of forestlands, they are not afraid to protect their forests from any foe.

gunits.dbf.description: Myzrael was sent to aid the human Empire in their holy quest. He guards the human capital against enemy invaders, never leaving it unprotected.

gunits.dbf.name: Vithar
gunits.dbf.description: Vithar the mighty is seated at the right of Wotan on his eternal feast table. He has been ordered to guard the capital, never to leave it.

gunits.dbf.name: Ashkael
gunits.dbf.description: Leader of 80 infernal cohorts, Ashkael was chosen by Bethrezen to guard the Legions capital, never to leave it unprotected.

gunits.dbf.name: Ashgan
gunits.dbf.description: Ashgan, bringer of plagues, was an Alkmaar high priest. He was ordered by Mortis to never leave the capital unprotected.

gunits.dbf.name: Merman
gunits.dbf.description: The Merman lies in wait of lost sailors, capturing and devouring the defenseless at sea.

gunits.dbf.description: Goblin archers accompany their fellows in ambushes and attacks, using crude arrows to wound their combatants.

gunits.dbf.name: Mermaid
gunits.dbf.description: The Mermaid paralyzes victims with its dazzling song, then feasts on the living flesh.

gunits.dbf.name: Sea Serpent
gunits.dbf.description: A grave danger while at sea, the Sea serpent has defeated many a great war vessel.

gunits.dbf.name: Master Thug
gunits.dbf.description: Master thugs lead wandering bands of thieves, they can craft poison elixirs.

gunits.dbf.name: Giant Spider
gunits.dbf.description: The Giant Spider's powerful venom renders his prey immobile; there is no escape for the paralyzed victims.

gunits.dbf.name: Elf Lord
gunits.dbf.description: The Elf Lord staunchly defends his people by summoning powerful storms.

gunits.dbf.name: Centaur Lancer
gunits.dbf.description: Centaur lancers are lovers of forestlands, they are not afraid to protect their forests from any foe.

gunits.dbf.name: Orc
gunits.dbf.description: Orcs of "Small mouth" status are used in the front lines of battle, being of tough build.

gunits.dbf.name: Master Thug
gunits.dbf.description: Master thugs lead wandering bands of thieves, they can craft poison elixirs.

gunits.dbf.name: Giant Spider
gunits.dbf.description: The Giant Spider's powerful venom renders his prey immobile; there is no escape for the paralyzed victims.

gunits.dbf.name: Demon
gunits.dbf.description: Demons inhabit the lower regions of Hell, they are more powerful than the lesser devils.

gunits.dbf.name: Zombie
gunits.dbf.description: Dead souls who have been transformed by ritual into mindless Zombies.

gunits.dbf.name: Hierophant
gunits.dbf.description: The Hierophant's devotion is such that he can revive dead warriors through ceremony.

gunits.dbf.name: Prophetess
gunits.dbf.description: The Prophetess is able to commune directly with the Highfather, her illumined word cures her comrades in battle.

gunits.dbf.name: White Wizard
gunits.dbf.description: White Wizards use pure magic to help the Highfather's followers.

gunits.dbf.name: Elementalist
gunits.dbf.description: Elementalists have mastered the winds, so to summon forth airy beasts in battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Imperial Assassin
gunits.dbf.description: The Imperial Assassin makes use of dark arts to kill its enemies.

gunits.dbf.name: Holy Avenger
gunits.dbf.description: The Holy Avenger is consumed by his earthly mission to fight evil.

gunits.dbf.name: Defender of Faith
gunits.dbf.description: The Defender of Faith guards against the profane beings that would fight the Highfather.

gunits.dbf.name: Grand Inquisitor
gunits.dbf.description: The Grand Inquisitor has withstood the fires and the terrors of Hell itself to oust evil influences from the realm.

gunits.dbf.name: Elder One
gunits.dbf.description: The most ancient of Dwarven warriors are the Elder Ones; they have learned well the art of war.

gunits.dbf.name: Son of Ymir
gunits.dbf.description: Descended from the greatest Dwarven warrior that ever lived, Sons of Ymir can kill with a single blow.

gunits.dbf.name: Archdruidess
gunits.dbf.description: The Archdruidess administers tonics to her warriors, which allows them to smite enemies with greater force.

gunits.dbf.name: Alchemist
gunits.dbf.description: Alchemists charm their allies, thereby granting them an extra attack during battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Forge Guardian
gunits.dbf.description: The Forge Guardian crafts his own weapons with care; his crossbow bolts are devastating.

gunits.dbf.name: Hermit
gunits.dbf.description: The Hermit masters the horn of war; gathering the Clans against invaders.

gunits.dbf.name: Wolf Lord
gunits.dbf.description: The Wolf Lord has dominion over the spirits of wolves, he can call upon their powers in battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Rune Master
gunits.dbf.description: The Runemaster is a fearsome warrior; he imbues his axe with runic magic.

gunits.dbf.name: Infernal Knight
gunits.dbf.description: Knights that once fought for the Highfather; Their souls have been corrupted to Bethrezen's purpose. They learned to regenerate their wounds as Empire cohorts.

gunits.dbf.name: Onyx Gargoyle
gunits.dbf.description: Hardened by the fires of hell, the Onyx Gargoyle is a threat to enemies of Bethrezen.

gunits.dbf.name: Tiamath
gunits.dbf.description: Attached to Bethrezen's hellish throne, Tiamath is only released during Bethrezen's demented frenzies.

gunits.dbf.name: Overlord
gunits.dbf.description: Overlords control the most unruly inhabitants of hell; occasionally they are needed aboveground.

gunits.dbf.name: Abyssal Devil
gunits.dbf.description: Abyssal Devils emerge from the depths of hell but rarely. Their appearance can make cowards of the most experienced of warriors.

gunits.dbf.name: Doppelganger
gunits.dbf.description: A Doppelganger has the unnatural ability to shape its form, thereby confusing his foe.

gunits.dbf.name: Modeus
gunits.dbf.description: Drawing strength from the fires of hell, Modeus wreaks fiery havoc on his enemies.

gunits.dbf.name: Succubus
gunits.dbf.description: Succubi are demons who cling still to pleasures of mortals. They can transform their opponents into anything they so wish.

gunits.dbf.name: Shade
gunits.dbf.description: The Shade's horrifying appearance inspires a paralyzing fear in all.

gunits.dbf.name: Elder Vampire
gunits.dbf.description: Elder Vampires cheat death by stealing the life essence of mortals.

gunits.dbf.name: Archlich
gunits.dbf.description: A sorcerer who prolongs his arcane studies far beyond his mortal lifetime becomes an archlich.

gunits.dbf.name: Death
gunits.dbf.description: The avatar and messenger of death, gathering souls in the land of the living.

gunits.dbf.name: Wight
gunits.dbf.description: These traitorous warriors prey upon the living as dreadful Wights.

gunits.dbf.name: Phantom Warrior
gunits.dbf.description: Warriors who betrayed their comrades in battle are condemned to fight forevermore.

gunits.dbf.name: Dreadwyrm
gunits.dbf.description: The Dreadwyrm is summoned up to rain poisonous malice upon the land.

gunits.dbf.name: Dracolich
gunits.dbf.description: This great undead dragon pours death down on its enemies.

gunits.dbf.name: Uther
gunits.dbf.description: Uther is the lost heir of the Empire. Bethrezen returns to Nevendaar in the form of this young boy.

gunits.dbf.name: Demon Uther
gunits.dbf.description: Completely transformed, Demonic Uther knows no fear and will crush whoever stands before his ambitions.

gunits.dbf.name: Air Elemental
gunits.dbf.description: The Air Elemental serves Elementalists who call them down from the planes of air.

gunits.dbf.name: Fat Imp
gunits.dbf.description: Imp servants of the higher infernal planes; these creatures are used by demons to disrupt order in the realm.

gunits.dbf.name: Hubert de Lalye
gunits.dbf.description: Distant parent of the Emperor, Hubert's ambition is to take over the throne and command the Empire.

gunits.dbf.name: Yataa' Halli
gunits.dbf.description: Daughter of the Clan Cloudkeeper, Yataa'Halli is a skillful warrior and a cautious diplomat.

gunits.dbf.name: Nhiddog
gunits.dbf.description: The Wyrm Nhiddog heralds the coming of Ragnarok: the twilight of the Gods. The enchanted Wyrm's touch enfeebles its opponent, draining them of needed strength.

gunits.dbf.name: Mage Hugin
gunits.dbf.description: A mage well versed in the art of magic, he knows the secrets of the ancestral runes.

gunits.dbf.name: Erhog the Dark
gunits.dbf.description: Master of death ceremonies, Erhog feeds only upon human flesh hoping to gain immortality.

gunits.dbf.name: Dark Elf Lyf
gunits.dbf.description: Once a noble Elf, Lyf's crimes resulted in his exile and he became something far more sinister.

gunits.dbf.name: Asteroth
gunits.dbf.description: Commander of eighty infernal cohorts, Asteroth is feared by all, for he strikes mercilessly allies and enemies alike.

gunits.dbf.name: Manticore

gunits.dbf.description: Hovering near battlefields to collect the fallen, these women warriors are fearsome when crossed.

gunits.dbf.description: From the very heart of the underworld comes Nebiros, a beast anointed with the blood of Bethrezen to fuel the flames of the Plague.

gunits.dbf.name: Grave Golem
gunits.dbf.description: As a necropolis made incarnate, the Grave Golem uses the power of 1000 departed souls to call the living to their final resting place.

gunits.dbf.name: Drullia'an
gunits.dbf.description: A pearl of virtue and justice, Drullia'an, heiress to queen Taladrielle comes forth to avenge the Elven people.

gunits.dbf.name: Gallean's Beast
gunits.dbf.description: When the Elven god Gallean used his life-giving gift to wish death on others, his spirit incarnated as this beast, the corruption of nature.

gunits.dbf.name: Spirit Wolf
gunits.dbf.description: These enchanted Wolves are of another world. They do not need the protection of fangs or claws, their powerful Sonic Howl assails their foe.

gunits.dbf.name: Lachla'an
gunits.dbf.description: Oracle of the Elven people, he speaks for Gallean to bring peace and hope in this time of strife and despair.

gunits.dbf.name: Dark Lachla'an
gunits.dbf.description: Mortis transformed the Elven Avatar into this mockery of purity. The Dark Elf Lachla'an uses his new allies, the Black Dragons, to bring down those who offend Mortis.

gunits.dbf.name: Count Flamel Crowley
gunits.dbf.description: A puppet to Dark Lords, the Count Flamel Crowley seeks to reunite the Empire under ultimate justice, at any cost.

gunits.dbf.description: The Forest Liege is an Elf of the purest bloodline who draws arms to protect his people.

gunits.dbf.name: Dryad
gunits.dbf.description: Playful spirits of the trees, Dryads wield powerful natural magic and possess a keen understanding of staffs and scrolls.

gunits.dbf.name: Guardian
gunits.dbf.description: Guardians are fierce Centaur archers whose speed and durability allow them to travel great distances.

gunits.dbf.name: Sage
gunits.dbf.description: The oldest of Elvenkind, Sages use arcane rods to spread grove mana throughout Nevendaar.

gunits.dbf.name: Thief
gunits.dbf.description: The Gladeshadow is a whisper in the leaves. She is a master of deception and thievery.

gunits.dbf.name: Centaur Lancer
gunits.dbf.description: An expert at polearms, the Centaur Lancer is a formidable protector of his Elven allies.

gunits.dbf.name: Centaur Charger
gunits.dbf.description: Proudly displaying the finest in Elven armor, the Centaur Charger leads the cavalry into battle.

gunits.dbf.name: Centaur Strider
gunits.dbf.description: The wild Centaur Strider cleaves through opposition without remorse.

gunits.dbf.name: Centaur Savage
gunits.dbf.description: A nightmare on the battlefield, the Centaur Savage has completely lost himself to the hunt.

gunits.dbf.name: Scout
gunits.dbf.description: Elven Scouts often silence the enemy with a well placed arrow before they are even seen.

gunits.dbf.name: Hunter
gunits.dbf.description: The Elven Hunter is a predator of the forest and all that lies within is prey for his bow.

gunits.dbf.name: Stinger
gunits.dbf.description: One shot from an Elven Stinger will eventually prove fatal. Vile poisons drip from the tips of each arrow they nock.

gunits.dbf.name: Bandit
gunits.dbf.description: The lawless Bandit is a scourge upon unsuspecting travellers.

gunits.dbf.name: Watchman
gunits.dbf.description: As part of the Queen's guard, the Watchmen are trained to conjure enchanted arrows.

gunits.dbf.name: Warden
gunits.dbf.description: The Warden conjures the essence of fire to drive bolts of flame into the hearts of trespassers.

gunits.dbf.name: Sentry
gunits.dbf.description: The fury of winter unleashed, the Sentry pushes back the enemy's front lines with deadly arrows of solid ice.

gunits.dbf.name: Adept
gunits.dbf.description: An Adept experiments with the deadly forces of nature and practices them upon his opponents.

gunits.dbf.name: Channeler
gunits.dbf.description: A Channeler can guide lightning from the heavens straight into the enemy ranks.

gunits.dbf.name: Archon
gunits.dbf.description: Highest in the ranks of noble Elf society, the Archon is the epitome of Elven magic.

gunits.dbf.name: Theurgist
gunits.dbf.description: The Theurgist harnesses the power of a raging storm to shatter the armor of his rivals.

gunits.dbf.name: Griffin
gunits.dbf.description: The majestic Griffin furiously protects his Elven masters from danger.

gunits.dbf.name: Skylord
gunits.dbf.description: Every few years, a Skylord hatches among the Griffin flock. It is the grandest of its kind and incredibly loyal to the Elves.

gunits.dbf.name: Spiritess
gunits.dbf.description: The Spiritess emerges from the forest to tend to the wounded in times of war.

gunits.dbf.name: Oracle
gunits.dbf.description: Elven Oracles are not only gifted healers, they are able to sense and interpret the will of Gallean.

gunits.dbf.name: Grovemaiden
gunits.dbf.description: Grovemaidens perform sacred rituals to grant protection against earth, air, fire, and water to an ally in need.

gunits.dbf.name: Sun Dancer
gunits.dbf.description: The Sun Dancer is a marvelous healer. She can walk through fire, and, if she desires, bring another with her.

gunits.dbf.name: Sylph
gunits.dbf.description: Violent winds and storms are nothing to a Sylph. She dismisses them to protect the Elves while she heals.

gunits.dbf.name: Ent Minor
gunits.dbf.description: A magical sapling uproots to defend the forest.

gunits.dbf.name: Ent
gunits.dbf.description: Elves plead with the forest spirits to aid them and often an Ent answers their call.

gunits.dbf.name: Ent Major
gunits.dbf.description: When the forest itself is angered, the mightiest of Ents awakens to deliver its wrath.

gunits.dbf.name: Verdant
gunits.dbf.description: Animated by Elven magic, the Verdant is a golem constructed from the heart of the forest.

gunits.dbf.name: Illumielle
gunits.dbf.description: Queen Illumielle struggles to bring the wild and noble sides of her people together while defending her home with unrivalled magic.

gunits.dbf.name: Dark Elf Butcher
gunits.dbf.description: Fueled by hatred, the Butcher is a reanimated Elf who died unjustly.

gunits.dbf.name: Dark Elf Reaper
gunits.dbf.description: Lost in the confusion of undeath, the Reaper unleashes his arrows where Mortis directs.

gunits.dbf.name: Dark Elf Crone
gunits.dbf.description: The Crone is the corpse of an Elven magic user, summoned to serve the fleshless goddess.

gunits.dbf.name: Dark Elf Gast
gunits.dbf.description: Gasts were once noble Elves who suffered from a horrible plague. Death delivered them into Mortis' hands.

The Squire nobly offers protection to his weaker compatriots in battle, fighting off all attackers with his sword.
The Knight uses his divine strength to guard the Empire against iniquity.
The Imperial Knight's absolute faith propels him to defend the innocent, making him a formidable adversary.
The Witch-Hunter is immune to mind based attacks through his experience in battling evil forces.
Long devoted to the task of eradicating evil, the Inquisitor attacks with holy force and is not affected by mind based attacks.
The Archer's attack is swift and far-reaching, making him effective against magic-users that shield themselves behind their stronger comrades.
The Marksman has great skill with the bow; his arrows fly far and a single hit can mean death to his opponents.
The Apprentice unleashes lightning upon all enemy units, he attacks with vengeance from a distance.
Casting lightning with double the violence, the Mage shows no mercy to adversaries.
The Wizard is a peerless spellcaster; he calls down mighty bolts of lightning from the heavens.
As a healer, the Acolyte comes to the aid of one unit at a time in combat.
Priests can substantially heal damaged units. They patiently attend to one soldier at a time during battle.
The Imperial Priest is blessed with the ability to cure units; the wounded will recover much of their health under his individual care.
The Paladin has been granted the best armor in the land to staunchly defend his people against unholy forces.
An emissary of the Highfather, the Angel's holy lance smites all those who threaten the Empire.
The Cleric brings down divine aid to heal all injured in her party.
The Matriarch's prayers miraculously heal all in her party.
The Titan is an immense, stalwart creature; she towers far above enemy armies.
The Pegasus Knight is a noble fighter whose winged steed carries him high above forests and sea.
Traveling quickly around the realm, the Ranger is often sent on scouting missions by the King.
Master of the arcane, an Archmage is the only Empire leader who can use staffs and scrolls.
The Archangel claims land for the Empire by planting rods. The ground surrounding her rods magically converts into Empire soil.
Thieves are adept at mischief, and can sneak behind enemy lines to secure information important to the Empire's cause.
A powerful suit of armor come to life. It wields a mighty blade, destined to slay all foes.
The enchanted form of the earth Golem obeys its maker; it will stop only when its lifeless body is reduced to dust.
The Axe Thrower's great strength and ferocious fighting spirit allows it to reach any unit during battle.
Crossbowmen rain death upon their adversaries with each volley.
Flinging fire into the fray, the Flame Caster's attack reaches all members of the enemy party.
The Hill Giant possesses strength so great that it chooses an uprooted tree as its weapon.
The massive Rock Giant hurls giant boulders at its foe.
They descend from the skies to bring lightning storms down on all those who offend the Dwarves.
The Ice Giant is called from frigid mountain peaks to fight for the clan's cause.
The Tenderfoot's gentle arts increase the force of her allies in battle.
The magical potions of the Novice increase the damage of one unit in battle.
The Druidess is an adept who cures her allies and can magically add to the force of their weapon.
The Dwarf rushes valiantly into battle, knowing that Wotan protects the brave of heart.
The Warrior is always ready to battle for the glory of his God, Wotan.
The Veteran has meted out justice to many. He desires to one day die with honor in battle.
Dwarves rewarded for unusual skill in battle by being named King of their Clan. Dwarf Kings wear the finest dwarven armor.
Dwarves who have seen many years of battle, Venerable Warriors fight with the ferocity of those who have no fear of the world beyond.
Well adapted to hostile climes, the Mountaineer showers entire armies with icy shards culled from mountain glaciers.
Polar Bears reside in the snow-laden mountaintops of the realm; they defend against those who invade their territory.
With a thick hide and icy breath, the Yeti has sent many an adventurer to an early grave.
As warlike leaders, the King's Guards are sent to quell any danger that threatens the dwarven lands.
Engineers travel far and wide, keeping the High King informed of happenings in the Dwarven Lands.
The Loremaster collects the ancestral wisdom of the Clans and has the ability to use staffs and scrolls.
Chosen by Wotan to transform the land, the Dwarf Champion plants rods to expand the High King's territory.
A Thief has many tricks at his disposal that he employs to further the High King's cause.
Rocs are giant birds called down from the mountains to fight alongside the Clans in times of war.
Hovering near battlefields to collect the fallen, these women warriors are fearsome when crossed.
These statues are animated by the souls of fierce warriors of old.
The Demon Lord enslaves these strong-bodied peasants to fight in his infernal battles.
As humanity weakens in these possessed creatures, their violence becomes uncontrollable.
Demons have mastered the souls of these once holy warriors, their virtuous past has long been forgotten.
Those who obey blindly the orders of cruel leaders become stone demons in the afterlife; They suffer in infernal fires, and turn slowly to stone.
Marble Gargoyles are the winged demons of the sixth plane of hell; they are impervious to mind attacks and their bodies are too solid to be easily damaged.
This unclean being menaces the land for his dark Lord Bethrezen.
Demons inhabit the lower regions of Hell, they are more powerful than the lesser devils.
Molochs gain power and strength by devouring the souls of those they slay.
The great Beast the very form of maleficence, none can escape the reach of this monstrosity.
The Demon Lord is a sovereign of Hell; As such, they lead devilish armies for Bethrezen.
Humans that have an inborn affinity for evil; they call down fire on entire armies.
Dark Sorcerers can summon fiery rain to consume enemy forces.
The Demonologist creates a storm of Flames so powerful that no army can escape it.
The Incubus turns men to stone with his horrible death cries.
The Pandemoneous controls infernal fires, incinerating entire armies at once.
Witches dwell in the depths of forests; if bothered they have been known to retaliate by transforming the hated interlopers.
Hags have the ability to transform enemies into anything they desire.
The Fiend hides its misshapen form within a labyrinthine lair. Few can resist its furious attack.
The Duke's warlike spirit leads demons into battle, sword in hand.
The Counselor leads the vanguard of the Legions forces; he travels at high speed upon the lands.
The Archdevil is master of the arcane; he has knowledge of staffs and scrolls.

The Thief is valued for his skill in subterfuge.

The Avenger lives to punish those who doubt the authority of Bethrezen, ruler of hell.

A Specter's forceful spirit makes her paralyzing attack stronger.
Initiates have been trained to spread death and disease upon living armies.
Warlocks become more effective over time in their quest to spread pestilence on the lands.
The Necromancer has perfected his craft; pestilence will engulf any army he encounters.
Men who have rejected the words of the Highfather become vampires. They sustain themselves by draining the life force of innocents.

Wraiths pass over from the land of the undead to spread pestilence.
These Fighters live again to crush the enemies of Mortis.
Dead souls who have been transformed by ritual into mindless Zombies.
The Skeleton Warrior is compelled by the will of Mortis to fight alongside the Undead.
Great fighting unit of the undead, the Skeleton Champion raises his bony fists against the living.
Templars subvert religious rites in order to honor Queen Mortis. They are impervious to the elements.
Mortis grants the Dark Lords control over the elements as reward for their servitude.
The werewolf rampages by moonlight; He cannot be killed by any blade.
Sorcerers resurrect lifeless dragons, creating Wyverns to fight in their Undead armies.

Deathdragons terrorize the land from beyond the grave; their poisonous breath envelops entire armies during battle.

Nosferats drain the life force of their enemies in battle, weakening opponents while feeding thier own evil souls.
Female Necromancers live after death as the dreadful Lich Queen. Their unholy knowledge allows them to use staffs and scrolls.
Banshees plant rods on living soil and create from it a barren wasteland.

Frail skeletons magically animated and used by the Undead as scouts.
Evil Ents are brought from the undead world through dark ceremony.
Crazy creatures called from the imagination of dark sorcerers, Nightmares brings death to Mortis' enemies.
Death comes forth by Mortis' command to fell the mortal armies of the Earth.

The Beliarh is a horned menace summoned to fight Mortis' enemies.
The Avenger is a fiery creature whose flames scorch entire armies.
Elves have long used Griffins as mounts, but even alone they prove fearsome adversaries.
Barbarian tribes hail from the Northern Steppes, The Chieftain urges his warriors to go forth in search of treasure.
Peasants defend the little turf that they can call home.
The Mythological Red Dragon can be found near lava pits and volcanoes. Some say that they can live up to 4000 years
Lizard men are the strange offspring of the marshlands; they are said to be particularly fond of human flesh.
The Medusa is a solitary creature; she petrifies those who come too close with her gaze.
Ogres are thick-skulled warriors; they attack all comers without guile or stratagem.
Thugs assemble in bands to steal from unwary travelers and feeble peasants.
Forest Elves move swiftly, surveying the frontiers and alerting their people of any intruders.
The Oracle Elf is gifted in the use of the healing arts. The Elven gods chose these beings as their representatives.
Trolls are exceedingly strong and resistant to attack, having the ability to regenerate each day.
The Mermaid paralyzes victims with its dazzling song, then feasts on the living flesh.
Orc Champions lead greenskin armies in battle. Only orc's of the "Large Mouth" type can aspire to this position.
Goblins are distant relations of the orc family. They are not strong creatures, but are limber and cunning.
Centaurs are hotheaded fighters who will defend against any army.
Orcs of "Small mouth" status are used in the front lines of battle, being of tough build.
Mercenaries who make their mighty services available to all, for a price.
The Elf Lord staunchly defends his people by summoning powerful storms.
The Elf Ranger flings arrows at the enemy, and is able to attack from any distance.
The Spearman will fight ferociously for whomever offers the most coin.
Ghouls are dangerous undead creatures; they attack those who come across them with tricks of the mind.
Demons send the ignoble Imp on errands of mischief in the realm.

The most majestic of Griffins, skylords fight alongside the Elven race.
The Giant Spiders' venom is poisonous; They agressively pursue any enemy they detect.

A natural enemy of the Sea Serpent, the Kraken attacks seafarers that venture too close to its watery lair.
Orc Kings seize the throne by challenging their King to a fight to the death, making them the strongest of their kind.
Centaur lancers are lovers of forestlands, they are not afraid to protect their forests from any foe.
